section.heading: Waging, or attempting to wage war, or abetting waging of war, against the Government of India
section.html:
Whoever wages war against the [Government of India], or attempts to wage such war, or abets the waging of such war, shall be punished with death, or [imprisonment for life] [and shall also be liable to fine].

[Illustration.]

A joins an insurrection against the [Government of India]. A has committed the offence defined in this section.

* * * *
